newsitem.title: UK: Euro jet fueL gains another $3, EBV tender helps.
newsitem.headline: Euro jet fueL gains another $3, EBV tender helps.

text.p: European jet fuel gained a further $3 a tonne on Wednesday on the back of stronger futures after the $3 a tonne gain seen on Tuesday.
Barge premiums were firmer on the back of the German buy tender, but cargoes premiums eased a touch on uninterested buying.
May IPE gas oil last traded at $171.75 a tonne, up $3.00.

Traders said business was sparse with a morning bid on cargoes of May IPE +$20 cif NWE evaporating against an offer of May IPE +$22. With nearly all of continental Europe on holiday on Thursday some dealers thought the rest of the week was likely to be very slow.
"It could easily be washed out with only Friday left," said one London-based trader.

Barge premiums were a touch stronger at May Ipe +$19-19.50 fob ARA, although physical buying was slow. Traders said the buy tender by Germany's EBV compulsory oil stocks agency for 250,000 tonnes of jet fuel from May to end September was helping to push premiums higher.
"The tender material will be drawn from the barge market, so that is where we have seen the impact," said a dealer.
